method: Direct visual inspection of all three saved RGB, instance-mask and depth-edge panels.

rooms.observations: The window boundary, stacked-paper edges and desk clutter align with the RGB orientation. Fine edges around papers and cables are incomplete in the coarse mesh; no global rotation or flip is visible.
The monitor, whiteboard, desk edge and cabinet boundary align with RGB. Small items show approximate mesh boundaries without a systematic orientation error.
The picture boundary, bed outline, sloped ceiling and lamp pole align with RGB. The bedding boundary differs by a few pixels, consistent with approximate mesh geometry.

scope: Qualitative orientation and alignment evidence on three rooms; no IoU or pixel-perfect reconstruction claim.
